name: move-the-food
why: Opens on the Capitol paying the weapons factory 1,425 to 1 like a slot machine, turns the lobbyists into pigeons that YOU leads into the hospital with a trail of medicine bills, and lands on the vampire who banks the blood.

name: insurance-casino
why: Hooks on the one industry that should be on your side sleeping through an earthquake, and pays off with the dropped-dead patient as Customer of the Year and its HEALTHCARE sign flickering to CASINO.

name: politicians-want-two-things
why: Hooks on "Politicians want exactly two things: votes and money", then shows the whole job on one stage (70% begging, re-elected by one tomato fewer) and ends with the puppet theatre dropping round him.
